title: The dear knows you might try to be in time for your lectures.
html_source: The Irish word for God is the same for deer(fiadh). To avoid using God’s name in vain the people took to referring to him by the word “deer,” which in English usage became “dear.”

anchor.text: The dear knows you might try to be in time for your lectures.
